title: test: verify that umd bundles load successfully
body:
**Summary**

Similar to https://github.com/algolia/autocomplete/pull/1171.

While we already have an e2e test for InstantSearch.js, it's worth having basic tests for all our packages that are bundled in UMD.

I also fixed an issue that was surfaced thanks to this test, with the UMD bundle of `react-instantsearch-hooks` (now `react-instantsearch-core`).
